answer: SE_NEW's Drift is a methodology defined inside the se_new repository itself (owner cogito5170). It is NOT the Dutch art studio DRIFT (Lonneke Gordijn & Ralph Nauta); the two are unrelated and are kept apart here.
author: se_new repository (cogito5170); author of the text is not named in the files
verification: fulltext -- read in a local checkout of the repository; every quote below is re-checked verbatim by qa.research when a checkout is present
core_claims: DRIFT = Diffusion (확산) · Rhythm (리듬) · Intrusion (충격) · Freewriting (자유) · Truth (원장): free continuous writing without a plot, from a first sentence
Everything drawn is a starting point, not a script; only two things are unbreakable: no contradiction with what was already written, and no coincidence that solves the problem

The structure is the way mathematics extends: conservative extension that keeps the earlier system true while widening it (axioms = ledger, consistency = contradiction gate, new axiom = event, open problem = unclosed thread, bridge = fold)
Diffusion asks for new things AND bringing back earlier things one level up; cooling props (식은 소품) from the ledger are fuel, not a ban list
Intrusion: every ~2,000 chars a third party breaks the escalation; drawn from combined axes, seeded, never solving the problem
Gates are minimal; measures are returned as numbers but do not kill the text (과잉 기각은 글 자체를 없앤다)
mathdrift carries the same rules to search spaces: one operator per step from a fixed list, lineage enforced by the ledger, far jumps rare (JUMP_SHARE 0.2), inheritance needs >= 2 shared words
applied_here: gentle_monster/magazine/drift.py ports these rules to editorial concepts: ledger + lineage gate, one operator per step (detach/refine/associate/invert/revive/fold/leap), measured new/kept terms, cooling nodes revived, intrusions every 4 steps from WHO x HOW x MARK axes, and a second hard gate against presenting fiction as brand fact.
interpretation_not_in_source: Mapping 'contradiction' to 'presenting a fiction as a fact about the brand' is this project's reading, not a sentence in DRIFT.md
The outside disciplines (excavation, conservation, optometry ...) and their editorial devices are this project's lexicon; DRIFT.md draws events from WHO/HOW/MARK axes for prose, not disciplines
DRIFT generates prose with a model (Gemini); this magazine engine writes no prose with a model -- its text is composed from the research catalogue
operating_principle_note: 'Research broadly. Extract principles. Let ideas drift across disciplines. Transform the relationships. Produce something original.' is the project's operating principle from the brief -- it is NOT a quotation from SE_NEW.

quotes.text: 줄거리를 먼저 짜지 않는다. 첫 문장 하나에서 끝까지 흘러간다.

꺾이지 않는 것은 둘뿐이다. **앞에서 쓴 것과 어긋나지 않기**(모순), **우연이 문제를 풀지
않기**(편의주의). 나머지는 전부 자유다.
이 구조는 **수학의 확장 방식을 소설로 옮긴 것**이다.
| 증명의 흐름 | **표류** — 결론을 정해 두지 않고 한 줄이 다음 줄을 부른다 |
**게이트는 최소로 만든다. 자유도가 이 방식의 전부다.**
**사건은 미리 정해두지 않는다.** 목록 하나를 돌려 쓰면 세 번째부터 예측된다.
그래서 **발산 단계에는 게이트를 안 건다.** 엄밀성은 나중에 요구한다.
**한 낱말이 겹친 것은 물려받은 것이 아니다.**
